title: An Agentic Framework for Automated Power System Studies and Grid Connection Assessment
title_zh: 自动化电力系统研究与并网评估的智能体框架

paragraphs.en: Connecting new generation and demand to the grid depends on two scarce skills: checking applications against a large, changing body of regulation, and running the network studies that decide where and how a project connects. We present Grid Agents , an AI system that brings both together, and the methodology we use to evaluate it. The Grid Ontology is its knowledge system. It represents the regulation, standards and engineering knowledge that grid work depends on, makes it searchable, and evolves as the agents learn from use. Every answer drawn from it rests on evidence the agents cite. Grid Studio is an agent system specialised for power-system engineering. It works in its own engineering environment with domain tools and a study framework, draws on the Grid Ontology, and relies on established solvers for every number it reports. In both, engineers make the decisions. We bring eight published power-system benchmark families, previously scattered across separate papers, into one suite of 519 tasks, and we verify not only each answer but the work behind it, by replaying the agent’s tool calls. The Grid Ontology cites the right regulatory evidence more often than a general coding agent or retrieval pipelines, leads on LegalBench-RAG and ranks first on the public leaderboards of the Enterprise RAG Challenge and ViDoRe V3. Grid Studio scores highest on the 519 power-system tasks and is the fastest of all the systems we compare, both by a statistically significant margin. With an optimiser in the loop, its reinforcement packages cost 33–67% less on average than those the agent designs alone.

paragraphs.en: Each connection request needs two kinds of expert work. Regulatory work checks the application against legislation, grid codes and standards that run to thousands of pages and change as reform proceeds. Engineering work decides where the project can connect and what reinforcement it needs, by running power-flow, contingency (N-1) and short-circuit studies on a network model [ 25 , 63 ] . Both are slow and both are short of people.
paragraphs.zh: 每一项并网申请都需要两类专家工作。 合规性工作是依据长达数千页且随改革推进而不断变化的法律法规、电网准则和标准对申请进行审查。 工程工作则通过在网络模型上进行潮流、预想事故（N-1）和短路计算，决定项目可以在何处接入以及需要哪些加强措施 [ 25 , 63 ] 。 这两类工作都很缓慢，且都人手不足。

paragraphs.en: Agents built on large language models (LLMs) plan, call tools and act on the results [ 67 , 48 , 61 ] , which suits both tasks. They also fail in three ways that matter here. They write fluent text that no source supports [ 20 ] . They cannot be trusted with the arithmetic of large network equations. Finally, a correct answer does not show that the work behind it was correct. The same number can come from the right study, from memory or from a study of the wrong grid state, and most benchmarks grade only the number. Yet a connection decision commits costly network works and can be challenged by the applicant or the regulator, so the engineer must be able to show which study ran on which network.
paragraphs.zh: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能体能够规划、调用工具并根据结果采取行动 [ 67 , 48 , 61 ] ，这适用于两类任务。 它们还会以三种在此处相关的方式出错。 它们会写出没有任何来源支持的流畅文本 [ 20 ] 。 它们在大型网络方程的算术运算上不可信赖。 最后，一个正确的答案并不能证明其背后的工作是正确的。 同一个数字可能来自正确的研究、来自记忆，或来自针对错误电网状态的研究，而大多数基准测试只评判这个数字。 然而，接入决策会投入高昂的电网工程，并可能被申请方或监管机构质疑，因此工程师必须能够展示哪项研究是基于哪个电网运行的。

paragraphs.en: Retrieval-augmented generation conditions a model on passages fetched for the question [ 27 ] . In its common form a pipeline searches once and the model answers from what comes back. The search may be lexical or dense, often followed by a reranker [ 47 , 24 , 37 ] . It may also run over a graph built from the corpus [ 7 ] or follow a document’s own hierarchy [ 58 ] . Longer context windows do not remove the need to retrieve well [ 28 ] . Agentic approaches instead let the model decide what to retrieve and judge what it found [ 1 ] , or explore the corpus from a programming environment [ 69 ] . Because a reviewer must be able to check every source, the citations matter as much as the answer. Work on attributed generation measures whether citations support the claims [ 10 ] , and model judges score faithfulness and answer quality [ 8 , 71 ] . LegalBench-RAG [ 42 ] , built on CUAD [ 15 ] and related to LegalBench [ 14 ] , scores retrieval on exact character spans, which separates finding the right document from finding the right clause.
paragraphs.zh: 检索增强生成以针对问题所获取的段落作为模型的条件输入 [ 27 ] 。 在其常见形式中，流水线只搜索一次，模型根据返回的内容作答。 搜索可以是词法搜索或稠密搜索，之后常接一个重排序器 [ 47 , 24 , 37 ] 。 搜索也可以在基于语料库构建的图上进行 [ 7 ] ，或沿文档自身的层级结构进行 [ 58 ] 。 更长的上下文窗口并不能消除良好检索的必要性 [ 28 ] 。 智能体方法则让模型自行决定检索什么并评判所找到的内容 [ 1 ] ，或在编程环境中探索语料库 [ 69 ] 。 由于审阅者必须能够核查每一个来源，引用与答案同等重要。 关于归因生成的研究衡量引用是否支持所述论断 [ 10 ] ，模型评判器则对忠实度和答案质量打分 [ 8 , 71 ] 。 LegalBench-RAG [ 42 ] 基于 CUAD [ 15 ] 构建并与 LegalBench [ 14 ] 相关，以精确的字符区间对检索评分，从而将找到正确文档与找到正确条款区分开来。

paragraphs.en: In engineering work, the actions an agent takes are calls to power-system analyses whose methods are long established. A power flow solves the AC network equations for voltages and flows at one operating point [ 63 ] . Security standards require the system to survive any single credible outage [ 36 ] , so a contingency (N-1) analysis repeats the power flow with each element out of service. Short-circuit, stability and dynamic studies cover fault levels and the seconds after a disturbance [ 25 ] , and optimal power flow (OPF) finds the least-cost dispatch within network limits. Open-source solvers such as MATPOWER [ 72 ] , pandapower [ 54 ] and PowerModels.jl [ 5 ] implement these analyses, and several benchmarks take their answer keys from them. For an engineer, and for an agent, the difficulty lies less in the computation than in choosing which studies to run on which network state, and in reading the results against the rules.
paragraphs.zh: 在工程工作中，智能体所执行的动作是对电力系统分析方法的调用，而这些方法早已成熟。 潮流计算在一个运行点上求解交流网络方程，得到电压和潮流 [ 63 ] 。 安全标准要求系统能够经受任何单一可信故障 [ 36 ] ，因此预想事故（N-1）分析会针对每个元件停运的情况重复进行潮流计算。 短路、稳定和动态研究涵盖故障水平和扰动发生后的数秒过程 [ 25 ] ，最优潮流（OPF）则在网络约束下寻找成本最低的调度方案。 MATPOWER [ 72 ] 、pandapower [ 54 ] 和 PowerModels.jl [ 5 ] 等开源求解器实现了这些分析，若干基准测试的参考答案也取自它们。 对工程师和智能体而言，难点不在于计算本身，而在于针对哪种网络状态选择运行哪些研究，以及依据规则解读计算结果。

paragraphs.en: The GB Regulation Set is our own set of 45 questions on GB grid regulation, asked of the 27 documents of the GB corpus (6,347 pages). An R1 question is answered by one passage, an R2 question by a figure or table, and an R3 question only by combining passages. We built it evidence first. Passages and figures are sampled from the corpus, a model writes a question from each, questions the evidence does not support or that need no evidence are discarded, and the domain owner approves the rest (Appendix D ). paragraphs.en: On the regulatory benchmarks we compare the Grid Ontology with a general coding agent (Claude Code) that has the corpus as files and its own file and shell tools, with one-shot retrieval pipelines that search once and answer from their top eight results, and on the Enterprise RAG Challenge and ViDoRe V3 with their published entries. On the power-system benchmarks we compare Grid Studio with two coding agents as shipped, Claude Code and Codex CLI on GPT-6.1 sol, each with a shell, Python and the network as a file. We also compare it with Power-Agent [ 43 , 44 ] , which installs PowerMCP’s pandapower tools and PowerSkills’ playbooks into Claude Code, and with eleven base models, which answer without tools from the network given as text, among them the frontier models GPT-6.1 sol and Fable 5.1. Claude Code and Power-Agent run on the same model as our agents, and Power-Agent uses its tools and playbooks as their authors publish them. We also time each system’s agent work, the time it spends on model turns and tool runs. Appendix D gives the evaluation protocol.
paragraphs.zh: 在监管类基准上，我们将 Grid Ontology 与一个通用编码智能体（Claude Code）进行比较，该智能体将语料库作为文件并拥有自己的文件和 shell 工具；与一次性检索流水线进行比较，后者只检索一次并从其前八个结果中作答；并在 Enterprise RAG Challenge 和 ViDoRe V3 上与其已公布的参赛结果进行比较。 在电力系统基准上，我们将 Grid Studio 与两个开箱即用的编码智能体进行比较，即 Claude Code 和基于 GPT-6.1 sol 的 Codex CLI，二者均配备 shell、Python 以及作为文件提供的网络。 我们还将其与 Power-Agent [ 43 , 44 ] 进行比较，后者将 PowerMCP 的 pandapower 工具和 PowerSkills 的操作手册安装到 Claude Code 中；并与十一个基础模型进行比较，这些模型在无工具的情况下根据以文本形式给出的网络作答，其中包括前沿模型 GPT-6.1 sol 和 Fable 5.1。 Claude Code 和 Power-Agent 运行在与我们的智能体相同的模型上，且 Power-Agent 按其作者发布的形式使用其工具和操作手册。 我们还对每个系统的智能体工作进行计时，即其在模型轮次和工具运行上所花费的时间。 附录 D 给出了评估协议。

paragraphs.en: Power-Agent installs PowerMCP’s pandapower tools and PowerSkills’ playbooks into Claude Code, on the same model as Grid Studio, and comes close to Grid Studio’s score. paragraphs.en: The benchmarks pose single studies, so we tested the reinforcement stage of a connection study separately. In five studies on networks of 30, 118 and 2,000 buses, the last the synthetic Texas grid ACTIVSg2000 [ 3 ] , the agent designed the package twice on its own and twice with the optimiser, using the same model and catalogue of priced reinforcement works (Table 5 ). Both approaches cleared every overload the projects caused, as an independent AC N-1 check of each final network confirms. The optimiser’s packages were 33–67% cheaper on average.
paragraphs.zh: 这些基准测试均为单项研究，因此我们单独测试了连接研究中加固阶段的强化过程。 在针对 30、118 和 2,000 母线网络的五项研究中（其中最后一项为合成德州电网 ACTIVSg2000 [ 3 ] ），智能体两次自行设计了方案包，两次与优化器协同设计，均使用相同的模型和带价格的加固工程目录（表 5 ）。 两种方法都消除了项目造成的所有过载，这一点已通过对每个最终网络的独立交流 N-1 校验予以确认。 优化器的方案包平均便宜 33–67%。

paragraphs.en: Grid Agents is built on three principles. Answers rest on cited evidence, numbers come from established solvers, and engineers make the decisions. The Grid Ontology cites the right regulatory evidence more often than a general coding agent or retrieval pipelines, leads on LegalBench-RAG, and ranks first on the public leaderboards of the Enterprise RAG Challenge and ViDoRe V3. On 519 tasks from eight published power-system benchmark families, Grid Studio scores highest and needs the least agent work time, both by a statistically significant margin. With an optimiser in the loop, its reinforcement packages cost 33–67% less on average than those the agent designs alone.
paragraphs.zh: Grid Agents 建立在三项原则之上。 答案基于有引用的证据，数字来自成熟的求解器，决策由工程师做出。 Grid Ontology 在引用正确的监管证据方面比通用编码智能体或检索流水线更准确，在 LegalBench-RAG 上领先，并在 Enterprise RAG Challenge 和 ViDoRe V3 的公开排行榜上排名第一。 在来自八个已发表的电力系统基准测试族的 519 个任务上，Grid Studio 得分最高且所需的智能体工作时间最少，两者均以统计学显著的幅度领先。 在优化器参与的情况下，其强化包的平均成本比智能体独自设计的方案低 33–67%。

paragraphs.en: The coding agents and the base models solve the network in their own code or by themselves, so they report with their answer the solved states it rests on. We solve the required network ourselves and accept a power flow when the reported voltages match ours at every bus within 10 − 4 10^{-4} pu and 0.01 ∘ 0.01^{\circ} , up to a common angle shift, an N-1 or a comparison when each of its states does, and an OPF when its dispatch balances and respects every limit of the required network. In a control on 31 sampled tasks, this check accepted every correct state and rejected states solved with a required change left out, apart from two OPF tasks where that change does not bind. Base models receive the network as text in their prompt, or the question alone where the network is too large to fit.
paragraphs.zh: 编程智能体与基础模型自行在其代码中或独立求解该网络，因此它们在答案中报告其结论所依赖的已求解状态。 我们自行求解所需的网络，并在报告的电压在每个母线处与我们的结果在 10^{-4} pu 和 0.01^{\circ}（允许统一角度平移）误差范围内匹配时接受其潮流结果，当其每个状态都通过时接受其 N-1 或对比结果，当其调度满足平衡并遵守所需网络的所有限制时接受其 OPF 结果。 在对 31 个采样任务的对照实验中，该检查接受了每个正确的状态，并拒绝了遗漏某个必要变化而求解出的状态，只有两个该变化不起约束作用的 OPF 任务除外。 基础模型在提示中以文本形式接收该网络，或当网络过大无法放入时仅接收问题本身。

paragraphs.en: Strict pass carries half the weight because it is the result that matters in use, so a system whose work cannot be shown reaches at most half the score. Answer accuracy carries a quarter, so a correct answer without verified work still beats a wrong one. Closeness carries the last quarter. It equals 1 on every correct answer and only separates a near miss from a large error. A guess at a per-unit voltage near 1 earns much of it, so it never decides a pass.
paragraphs.zh: 严格通过占一半权重，因为它才是实际使用中真正重要的结果，所以一个无法展示其工作过程的系统最多只能得到一半分数。 答案准确度占四分之一，因此没有经过验证过程的正确答案仍然胜过错误的答案。 接近程度占最后的四分之一。 它在每个正确答案上都等于 1，仅用于区分险些答对与较大错误之间的差别。 对接近 1 的单位电压进行猜测也能获得其中大部分分数，因此它永远不会决定是否通过。

paragraphs.en: Every task is posed as a question about a stated network with one value to report, so that every system receives the same wording and is graded the same way. PFBench, PowerCodeBench and ProOPF-B publish such questions, and we ask them in their authors’ words. Where one omits a quantity or choice its answer depends on (156 of 352 PowerCodeBench and 6 of 19 ProOPF-B items), we restore it from the item’s own record, never adding the answer. PF Δ \Delta and PGLib-OPF publish networks and solved results but no questions, so we pose each task from a fixed template that names the network, any stated changes and the quantity to report. PowerAgentBench-SS releases task specifications without a question set, PSAB’s tasks are built for agents that work on files, and RL2Grid scores reinforcement-learning episodes rather than answers. For these three we keep the kind of study each one tests and write the questions ourselves, with answers from a reference solver. In all, 389 of the 519 questions are in their authors’ words and 130 are ours. Ours come from fixed templates, not from a language model.
paragraphs.zh: 每个任务都表述为对一个给定网络的问题，只需报告一个数值，从而使每个系统收到相同的措辞并以相同方式评分。 PFBench、PowerCodeBench 和 ProOPF-B 发布了此类问题，我们按其作者的原话提问。 当其中缺少答案所依赖的某个量或选项时（PowerCodeBench 352 项中有 156 项，ProOPF-B 19 项中有 6 项），我们从该条目自身的记录中将其补回，绝不添加答案。 PF Δ \Delta 和 PGLib-OPF 发布了网络及求解结果但没有问题，因此我们用固定模板提出每个任务，模板中指明网络名称、任何给定变化以及需报告的量。 PowerAgentBench-SS 发布任务规范但未附问题集，PSAB 的任务是为处理文件的智能体设计的，而 RL2Grid 评分的是强化学习回合而非答案。 对这三个基准，我们保留各自所测试的研究类型，自行撰写问题，答案来自参考求解器。 总计 519 个问题中有 389 个采用作者原话，130 个由我们撰写。 我们撰写的问题来自固定模板，而非语言模型。

paragraphs.en: Answer keys never come from the system under test. The regulatory keys are the published ones, apart from the GB Regulation Set’s, which the domain owner approved. PFBench, PowerCodeBench and ProOPF-B use their authors’ published answers, PF Δ \Delta its authors’ Ipopt solutions, and PGLib-OPF its published OPF baseline, with a reference solver for its power-flow tasks. The three adapted families (Table 2 ) are graded against a reference solver, so we treat them as weaker evidence. Run with no model, the reference solver reproduces every published answer of PFBench, PF Δ \Delta , PowerCodeBench and ProOPF-B (460 tasks), so a solver discrepancy is never counted as an agent failure.

paragraphs.en: Agent work is the time spent on model turns and tool runs, read from each agent’s own clock. It excludes start-up, which covers launching and tearing down the container and starting the agent and, for Grid Studio, its solvers. Codex CLI reports no such split, so its time is the whole run of its process, an upper bound. A base model spends all its time on one completion. Figure 1 reports the median over the 519 tasks. A coding agent loads its libraries inside its own scripts, while starting Grid Studio’s solvers, 6.7 s on average when we measured it, is not counted.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体工作时间是指花在模型轮次和工具运行上的时间，读取自每个智能体自身的时钟。 它不包括启动时间，启动时间涵盖容器的启动与销毁、智能体的启动，以及（对于 Grid Studio 而言）其求解器的启动。 Codex CLI 不报告这种区分，因此其时间是其整个进程的运行时间，是一个上限。 基础模型把所有时间都花在一次补全上。 图 1 报告了 519 个任务的中位数。 编码智能体在其自己的脚本中加载其库，而启动 Grid Studio 的求解器（据我们测量平均为 6.7 秒）则不计入其中。

paragraphs.en: Table 9 gives each system’s version and setting. The two base models in the table and the nine further ones in Figure 1 and Table 8 ran on the same 519 tasks between 29 and 31 October 2026, each with the network in its prompt, and were graded with the same grader. Grid Studio, Power-Agent and the base models ran once per task, and Codex CLI and Claude Code once on PowerCodeBench and five times on the other families. Where a provider’s quota ran out during a run, the remaining tasks ran on the same model through another provider (GPT-6.1 sol and Sonnet 5.5). paragraphs.en: At the clause level, agentic systems reach an F1 an order of magnitude above retrieval pipelines (0.47 to 0.62 against 0.03 to 0.09), so pipelines find the right contract but not the clause. In a sweep over chunking, hybrid search and embeddings [ 66 ] , no pipeline configuration exceeded a clause F1 of 0.13. PageIndex reaches clause recall 0.72 but precision 0.05, because it returns whole sections. The Grid Ontology leads on both clause and document F1, and Example A shows what clause-level scoring rewards.
paragraphs.zh: 在子句层面，智能体系统的 F1 比检索流水线高出一个数量级（0.47 到 0.62 对比 0.03 到 0.09），因此流水线能找到正确的合同，却找不到对应的子句。 在对分块、混合检索和嵌入 [ 66 ] 的遍历实验中，没有任何流水线配置的子句 F1 超过 0.13。 PageIndex 的子句召回率达到 0.72，但精确率仅为 0.05，因为它返回的是整个章节。 Grid Ontology 在子句和文档两个层面的 F1 上均领先，而示例 A 展示了子句级评分所奖励的内容。
